rationale: The change introduces an explicit configurable braking-zone definition in place of the previously unspecified dangerous-zone boundary. According to the baseline, H1-CRD3 and H1-ORR3 depend on FR-7.1 and on the dangerous-zone definition / spatial-distance basis used to determine whether braking is required. This changes the required Concern-Relevant Distinction for the braking-relevant distance class, while the Evaluation Target and Phenomenon of Interest remain applicable. Therefore the derivation must resume at RR3 rather than merely revalidating an existing ORR.
